issue.title: Contract manifest budget exceeds its cap after a new marked test
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_set_manifest_entry_budget_has_no_hidden_headroom`

ToolRuns 75613688b95536aaaa6fd075fb4c9073 and 37526937388d05b5dbe54f6869a0452f both escalated `just check` to the full lane and failed this node. The latter reports `tests/contract_manifest.txt contains 85 entries, over the 84-entry contract-set budget`; `tests/test_github_actions_release_steward.py` is newly selected and present in the working manifest. The budget assertion names `tests/test_validate_test_environment_tool.py` as the entry over budget. Re-curate the contract set by value per second and update its measured-cost comment/cap as appropriate.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: It failed in two separate full-lane just check ToolRuns with the same deterministic 85-versus-84 entry count; the latest traceback names the same over-budget manifest entry.

issue.creation_reason: Two independent full-lane just check runs fail the same deterministic contract-manifest budget assertion. The deck-focus work does not change the contract set; curation is needed to restore the configured budget.
